content.text: I am not sure exactly which classes are in scope for this task, but in general, I prefer the guaranteed existence of instance variables provided by dependency injection via constructors versus via setters.

From my initial poking about it looks like we'd just have to declare the bean refs for implementations of Migrator, ObjectSouce, and FedoraObjectHandler.  ObjectSource and FedoraObjectHandler beans will have implementations determined by command line arguments, and will get injected into the Migrator.
+1 AWoods.  Agreed.  That's how the Migrator's set up now.  We should keep that pattern.
"Constructor arguments vs. method parameters" is orthogonal to whether or not DI is in use at all.

The habit in much of the rest of the F4 work has been to use a constructor argument only when there is no sensible default for the reference but the reference must be available. That's hardly universal, tho'.
Do we have to use command line args for migrator? I don't have a good way to pass them to bean. Any suggestion?
We don't.  Perhaps all the configuration will take place in a spring configuration file and there won't be any need for command line arguments.
I create a pull request at
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/migration-utils/pull/1
for my current changes.

You'd asked on IRC about how best to make the tests pass.  Using your code as an example, I issued a PR to your branch that I think addresses the tests in a way that's standard for fcrepo4 projects (ie, different spring xml files for different tests).
If you think it's reasonable, you can merge it into your branch and it'll be merged into your PR against the main project.
https://github.com/nianma/migration-utils/pull/1
, thank you! I think it makes sense to create multiple configurations. I will merge it. Could you also point me to the coding standard for fcrepo4 projects?
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Code+Style+Guide
The checkstyle rules are enforced by the build system (Maven) for the main fcrepo4 project.
I have made a few Spring-related comments in GitHub. If you choose not to use annotations, please use "constructor-args" instead of "properties" where you can.
? Is this ticket done? Should I close it?

Yeah, the work is complete.  It's possible we'll want to make an additional ticket to "update spring implementation to use annotations" which was one suggestion in the review comments, but I don't think it's a top priority.
Resolved with:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/migration-utils/commit/d35c42c5e628f8e42e496c375ef8276da66b5e10
The current version of the code uses constructors rather than dependency injection for configurable and pluggable components.  For this task, simply refactor it to use spring best practices.
